name: electron-p2p-media-sdk
description: Production-grade Electron P2P Media SDK and Application

scripts.build: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main/index.js --external:electron && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/preload/index.js --external:electron && esbuild src/renderer/index.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/renderer/index.js --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/renderer', {recursive: true}); require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/index.html', 'dist/renderer/index.html');"
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && npx -y electron-packager . P2PScreenShare --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('release/P2PScreenShare-Portable.zip')) fs.unlinkSync('release/P2PScreenShare-Portable.zip'); console.log('Zipping portable application package...'); execSync('powershell Compress-Archive -Path ./release/P2PScreenShare-win32-x64/* -DestinationPath ./release/P2PScreenShare-Portable.zip -Force', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('✅ Created release/P2PScreenShare-Portable.zip');"
